articles.title: Smaller tokens lead as bitcoin, sol rally in 'first real bounce of the selloff'
articles.snippet: Bitcoin and major cryptocurrencies rebounded on dovish Federal Reserve signals, with speculative tokens like Memecore’s M and Audiera’s BEAT leading gains.

articles.title: Zcash’s Ironwood upgrade faces possible delay over infrastructure readiness
articles.snippet: Shielded Labs said exchanges, mining pools and wallets may need more time to complete Zcash’s Z3 software migration and safely prepare for Ironwood.

articles.title: Teen ‘Scattered Spider’ suspect extradited to US over $8M crypto ransom
articles.snippet: Peter Stokes, 19, has been charged in the US for allegedly taking part in a hacking group’s unsuccessful $8 million crypto ransom scheme.

articles.title: Is Bitcoin heading for $65K? Sharplink buys $16M ETH: Market Moves
articles.snippet: Analysts are divided on Bitcoin's next move, but there's some hope at last. Meanwhile, SharpLink has resumed buying Ether after an eight-week pause, and other market news.

articles.title: Securitize Begins Trading on NYSE as Tokenized Shares Land on Solana, Avalanche
articles.snippet: BlackRock-backed tokenization firm Securitize now has shares trading on the New York Stock Exchange—or via Solana and Avalanche.
